name: Eman Zied
researchKeywords: spatial health inequalities, climate and health, built environment, heatwaves
bio: Dr Eman Zied, PhD is a Research Fellow and geospatial data scientist affiliated with the Addressing Inequity in Health and Care Systems theme at NIHR ARC North East and North Cumbria.
researchFocus: Eman studies the interplay between social, spatial and health inequalities, including the spatial determinants of health and climate. Her work examines vulnerability and hospitalisation during heatwaves, the effects of built and natural environments on health, cognitive health, high-street health amenities and community pharmacy distribution in deprived areas.
